global_state: Earth under alien invasion. 98% of humanity vanished into tutorial space at dawn. Streets empty. Alien ships in low orbit over all major cities. Taker drones deploying into urban centers. System active — F-rank awakenings ongoing.
active_threats: Alien ship in low orbit over Lindenauer Hafen, Leipzig
Taker drones — cataloging urban centers, expanding outward

companion_system.label: Demon
companion_system.description: The companion in this world is the Inner Demon — a fragment of the player's own psyche, manifesting after their first death. The Inner Demon and the companion system are the same feature. Born from fears and failures. Not purely evil — it judges, teaches, and fights for dominance.
